verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's first-party workflow automation feature lets users "set up flows and triggered events so that tasks happen without you having to lift a finger" [pipedrive-docs-7]. It also includes built-in automations such as lead scoring and automatic lead assignment [pipedrive-docs-8], which covers the core of event-triggered rules. The evidence is marketing-level only, so the depth of what rules can do is unshown. Missing for 10: detailed docs on available trigger events, conditions and action types; any limits on rule complexity; independent or hands-on corroboration of the automation builder.
